newsitem.title: USA: Flores & Rucks ups 1997 drilling budget.
newsitem.headline: Flores & Rucks ups 1997 drilling budget.

text.p: Flores & Rucks Inc said on Monday it increased its 1997 drilling budget by 33 percent to $200 million.

The increase was funded by additional cash flow from anticipated increases in production, as well as through the realization of higher than anticipated commodity prices and the possible disposition of non-strategic assets.

"With our current project inventory and unique ability to bring on production quickly because of our existing large production infrastructure, we are well positioned to take advantage of the higher commodity pricing currently enjoyed by the industry," James Flores, chairman and chief executive officer, said.
"As such, we believe it is prudent to capitalize on the favorable market conditions which exist by increasing our planned 1997 activities," he said.
